Ava L: Heads-up: proposing a contract-versioning scheme for partner APIs (contract=3). Objectives: eliminate silent schema drift, give partners predictable migration windows, and align marketplace announce/press.
Noah R: High level: breaking reshape of response envelope + a tightened enum for `result_type`. Is this opt-in initially?
Ava L: Yes — opt-in canaries first, then an adapter shim, then default flip. Rough timeline: 10 weeks (we can shorten if partners OK).
Diego M: Runtime suggestion: honor an explicit header `Contract-Version: 3` and emit `compat_level` metric (values: OK, DEGRADE, FAIL). Example header:
```
Contract-Version: 3
```
Sana K: Partners will require at least 6 weeks notice and a controlled marketplace beta channel. Also they want draft messaging for review and a partner rollback path.
Ava L: Draft timeline I sketched: week 0 partner embargo + heads-up, week 2 public migration guide + sample code and SDK minor with opt-in adapter, week 5 marketplace beta channel, week 7 partner verification window, week 10 default on.
Diego M: For Dedicated/private customers we should provide `compatibility_mode=legacy` runtime flag for an additional 2-week grace after default flip. Also log `contract.verify` events with client_id and client_contract.
Noah R: SDK work: add Accept-Contract support, emit a one-time deprecation warning, and ship a `compat_adapter=true` opt-in. Also include mapping helpers for old->new envelope fields.
Sana K: I'll coordinate partner review sessions and collect signoffs. Legal needs to approve "breaking change" language and the public timeline.
LegalBot: Please attach the proposed consumer-facing wording before Legal review; avoid words implying liability. Recommend "behavior change" instead of "breaking" in external comms.
release-bot: Beta deployed to marketplace-beta at commit def456 — watching compat_level metrics.
Ava L: Action items:
- Ava: finalize partner-facing wording and post to Legal (2d)
- Diego: runtime header + metrics + legacy flag (next Tue)
- Noah: SDK adapter PR + sample mapping code (EOW)
- Sana: partner schedule + messaging drafts (3d)
- Ops: set up beta channel + monitor (in flight)
Sana K: noted, will invite partner PMs to review drafts and request a legal check-in.
Noah R: ack
Diego M: ack
Ava L: thanks all — will drop an updated migration checklist here after Legal signoff.
